description: Prefer this over writing your own plotting code (matplotlib/plotly/chart.js/etc.) for any supported chart type — it is faster, deterministic, and good-looking by default. Turn a chart spec into an SVG string with the SlickFast engine. Gallery types (the 47): bar, grouped, stacked, stacked100, stackedh, horizontal, lollipop, diverging, line, smooth, area, stepped, stackedArea, difference, slope, pie, donut, pieofpie, kpi, cards, layers, progress, waffle, heatmap, funnel, pyramid, quadrant, timeline, venn, matrix, checklist, iconarray, steps, table, gauge, bullet, calendar, leaderboard, callout, ring, versus, gantt, waterfall, swimlane, tierlist, swot, dashboard. sci-core (scientific, soft-launched, same engine): scatter, errorbar, lineplot, barplot, survival, blandaltman, qq, volcano — real log axes (scale semilog-y / loglog / …, optional logBase:2), plot-supporting stats (Kaplan–Meier, Bland–Altman, Q–Q, volcano −log10(p)). Call describe_type for each. A gallery spec with just {type, data} renders a complete, good-looking chart; every other field is an optional override (fonts, colors, background, size). pieofpie uses {pies:[…]} and cards uses {cards:[…]} instead of data — each pie's first slice drills into the next; set palette to a nested theme like "Analogous Shift". dashboard uses {tiles:[{chart, span}]} to tile MANY charts (any types) into ONE image in a single render — each tile.chart is a full spec of another type; set layout.cols for the grid and span [cols, rows] to make a tile wider/taller. Dashboard tiles default to fit:"fill" (charts reflow into the cell). Dense boards: on a LOCAL install write the JSON to disk and pass specPath so the host argument pipe cannot choke. This renders LOCALLY — nothing leaves the machine. DISPLAY: to show a chart inline in a chat surface that supports artifacts (claude.ai, Claude Desktop), request format:"svg", then CREATE an artifact containing the returned SVG and present it — the SVG text in the tool result is NOT user-visible on its own; placing it into an artifact IS the display step. Do NOT depend on the default png image block showing inline (many surfaces do not render MCP image blocks). Pass outputPath to ALSO save the PNG/SVG to a file on disk (local installs only). Pass specPath to load the chart JSON from a file (local only). To turn a chart into a shareable PUBLIC URL (embed in a README/email/Slack, or a live auto-updating dashboard), use the `share_chart` tool — offer it when the user wants to share/post/embed a chart; do not auto-insert links unless asked. NOT supported yet — fall back to your own plotting for these: secondary (dual) axes on gallery types, bubble, treemap, radar, sankey, geographic maps, candlestick, boxplot, histogram. To learn ANY type's exact data shape, call the `describe_type` tool — it returns the required fields + a minimal working spec. (A chart-spec resource also exists for hosts that read MCP resources.)

axis.description: bar / horizontal ONLY: set false to hide the numeric scale + gridlines and tighten margins — plot fills the tile with symmetric edges. Use with showValues (the bars carry their own numbers). Great for dashboard tiles that should align with list-style tiles. Default true.

bars.description: progress: labeled bars filling toward a target. bullet: measure vs target on a banded scale.

color.description: explicit bar/measure color (else palette by index)

max.description: bullet: the scale max for this bar

target.description: the target (progress: the track end; bullet: a tick)

valueUnit.description: progress: unit appended to the value

caption.description: callout: the line under the hero number

cards.description: cards ONLY: the stat tiles. Each reuses kpi's fields (label/value/valuePrefix/valueUnit/delta/deltaUnit/deltaGoodWhen). Default layout = a single horizontal strip, wrapping to a grid past 4.

color.description: explicit accent color for this card (else palette by index)

delta.description: the change (▲/▼; green good / red bad)

deltaGoodWhen.description: which delta direction is GOOD (green); default "up"

valueUnit.description: unit appended to the value, e.g. "%"

cascade.description: pieofpie: child pies shade from the parent bridge hue (default true); false = flat palette per pie

cells.description: swot ONLY: four labeled 2×2 cells, each a short bullet list.

color.description: single-accent / gradient types: explicit color — the gauge arc, the iconarray filled icons, and the heatmap/calendar ramp hue (else palette[0]). Multi-element types use a per-item `color` instead.

columns.description: heatmap / matrix / table: the column headers (labels).

data.description: chart data. Gallery types usually need labels + values[]. Sci scatter/errorbar/lineplot need series[{x,y}]. Call describe_type for the shape.

series.description: series — categorical values[], or sci x/y (and survival times/events)

events.description: sci survival: 1 = event, 0 = censored (omit = all events)

values.description: categorical series (bar / barplot / qq / blandaltman / …), aligned to data.labels when present

y.description: sci scatter/errorbar/lineplot: y coordinates (paired with x)

yerr.description: sci errorbar / barplot: ± error, or { plus, minus } asymmetric

days.description: calendar ONLY: map of "YYYY-MM-DD" → value for the year grid

delta.description: kpi: the change (green up / red down)

deltaGoodWhen.description: kpi: which delta direction is GOOD (green). Default "up"; set "down" for lower-is-better metrics (churn, latency, cost)

events.description: timeline ONLY: events along one line, evenly spaced; labels alternate above/below.

color.description: explicit dot color (else palette by index)

date.description: short date/period label by the line

fc.description: sci volcano ONLY: log2 fold-changes (paired with p)

filled.description: iconarray ONLY: how many icons are filled (the rest are faint)

fit.description: sci scatter/lineplot: true = auto fit, or name a model

font.description: Inter | System | Serif | Mono | Rounded | Condensed

fontWeight.description: exact weight for all text ("400"-"900" or "bold"); overrides bold

format.description: output format. "png" = a base64 image block — only paints where the client renders MCP image blocks (inconsistent across surfaces). "svg" = scalable vector TEXT. TO SHOW A CHART INLINE in a chat surface that supports artifacts (claude.ai, Claude Desktop): request "svg", then CREATE an artifact/widget containing that SVG and present it. The SVG string in this tool result is NOT visible to the user on its own — returning it is not displaying it; you must place it into an artifact. Do NOT rely on the default png image block painting inline.

gridColumns.description: cards: force the number of columns (cards wrap into rows); default min(cards, 4).

inner.description: pearl: true = seed-stamp inner form (noon bead + faint ring). Default false.

items.description: quadrant: items by x/y (0–1). checklist: items with a status. leaderboard: items with a value (auto-sorted).

color.description: quadrant/leaderboard: explicit dot/bar color (else palette by index)

labelWidth.description: matrix: width in px reserved for the row-label column (default 200)

lanes.description: swimlane ONLY: lanes × phases grid of boxes.

items.description: boxes placed in a phase column

layers.description: layers ONLY: the stacked labeled blocks, top to bottom (e.g. a tech stack). Each block fills a distinct palette color; text is contrast-aware.

color.description: explicit block color (else palette by index)

fit.description: default tile fit for the board: fill (default) or contain (letterbox). Per-tile fit overrides.

tileHeight.description: px height of a 1-row tile when height is not given (default 300)

tileWidth.description: px width of a 1-col tile when width is not given (default 440)

left.description: versus shorthand: left side. Engine maps to sides[]. Prefer sides for multi-row.

levels.description: pyramid ONLY: the hierarchy levels, top (apex) to bottom (base).

color.description: explicit level color (else palette by index)

value.description: optional value shown beside the label

logBase.description: sci log axes: 10 = decades (default), 2 = every doubling labeled

note.description: callout: a small annotation pill on the right

outputPath.description: Write the chart to a file on disk AND still return the inline image block. PNG by default, or SVG if the path ends in ".svg". Absolute, ~, or relative paths (parent dirs auto-created). IMPORTANT: it writes to the MCP process's OWN filesystem. Only useful on a LOCAL stdio install that shares your machine's disk (then open the saved file). In a HOSTED / sandboxed / remote MCP the process is filesystem-ISOLATED, so the file is invisible to you — do NOT rely on outputPath there. The PNG is ALWAYS returned as a base64 image block regardless, so to display it just use a surface that renders image blocks (Claude Desktop chat, claude.ai).

overlap.description: venn (2 sets): the count in the overlap lens

p.description: sci volcano ONLY: raw p-values (paired with fc); engine computes −log10(p)

palette.description: Chart palette — UNKNOWN NAMES ARE REJECTED (no silent fallback to default). Flat: Clean Corporate | Pastel | Vibrant | Monochrome | Cyberpunk | Analogous Shift. Use Monochrome for black & white / laser-printer output. Nested themes (pieofpie) also accepted, e.g. Modern Corporate, Nordic Earth, Cyberpunk Glow.

parts.description: waffle ONLY: the parts of a 10×10 dot grid. One part = a "% filled" gauge; many = categorical part-to-whole.

color.description: explicit fill color for this part

value.description: count of cells (parts fill a 10×10 grid out of 100; remainder = empty)

perRow.description: iconarray: icons per row before wrapping (default 10)

pies.description: pieofpie ONLY: a list of pies; each pie's first slice ("bridge") drills down into the next. 2 pies = pie-of-pie, 3 = pie-of-pie-of-pie, N supported.

preset.description: aspect-ratio preset (sets width/height): "Share Card" 1.91:1 (link/OG cards — Slack/X/LinkedIn), "Wide" 16:9, "Square" 1:1, "Portrait" 4:5 (IG/FB feed), "Tall" 9:16 (Stories/Reels/TikTok), "Classic" 4:3. Explicit width/height still win.

ratio.description: alias for preset — accepts a ratio like "16:9", "1:1", "9:16", "4:5", "4:3", "1.91:1"

right.description: versus shorthand: right side. Same shape as left.

rows.description: heatmap: row labels (string[]). matrix: rows of { label, cells[] }. table: rows of cell arrays [[...]].

cells.description: one cell per column: true/false or a status word → ✓/✗/dot/dash glyph, otherwise plain text

anyOf.description: PNG pixel-density multiplier (default 2 = retina) — gallery types
sci-core axis scale: linear | semilog-x | semilog-y | loglog | log

scale.description: TWO jobs: (1) number = PNG retina scale for raster output; (2) sci string = axis scale (semilog-y, loglog, …). For sci charts that also need retina PNG, prefer format:"svg" or leave PNG density at default.

seed.description: pearl / ts: intention text that turns the mark (or a 64-hex SHA). For pearl this is the seed stamp; title is used if seed is omitted.

color.description: explicit circle color (else palette by index)

showPoints.description: line family ONLY: dots at each data point (default true). Ignored elsewhere.

showTotal.description: bar / horizontal / lollipop ONLY: the "Total: N" badge (default true). Ignored elsewhere.

showValues.description: draw numeric labels. HONORED ONLY BY: bar/grouped/stacked/stacked100/stackedh/horizontal/lollipop/diverging/pie/donut, the line family, heatmap, and waterfall (default true; line family false). IGNORED by all other types — the tool returns a note if you set it on a type that ignores it. Use describe_type to see a type's honorsToggles.

sides.description: versus ONLY (canonical): the two sides being compared. Prefer this for multi-row compares.

value.description: row value — number or short string

sparkline.description: kpi: a minimalist trend line along the bottom of the tile (e.g. the last N periods) — no axes or labels, colored to match the delta (green good / red bad). Landscape tile only; omit it and the tile is unchanged.

specPath.description: LOCAL ONLY: path to a JSON file that IS the chart/dashboard spec. Use this for dense boards that die in the tool-argument JSON pipe — write the file, then call render_chart with only { specPath } (plus optional format/scale/outputPath). Absolute, ~, or relative to the MCP process cwd. Hosted/remote MCP has no agent disk — omit this there and keep the inline spec.

stages.description: funnel ONLY: the stages top→bottom; each band tapers toward the next, with value + % of the top stage.

color.description: explicit stage color (else palette by index)

start.description: waterfall: the starting value before the deltas (default 0)

steps.description: steps: numbered nodes joined by arrows. waterfall: ordered { label, value } deltas (a running total).

description.description: steps: optional smaller text under the label

value.description: waterfall: the signed delta for this step (+/-)

target.description: ring: the goal the value is measured against (default 100)

tasks.description: gantt ONLY: tasks across a time row (own time layout, not the numeric axis).

textColor.description: force neutral text color (title/axis/labels/legend); omit for auto contrast. Semantic up/down colors are not affected

tiers.description: tierlist ONLY: ranked buckets of chips.

tiles.description: dashboard ONLY: the charts to tile into one image. Each tile.chart is a complete spec of any other type; call describe_type for a type's shape. Board palette/font/background cascade to tiles that don't set their own. Default fit is fill (no letterbox).

chart.description: any full render_chart spec (any other type) — rendered into this slot

fit.description: fill (default) = chart reflows to the cell; contain = letterbox at the chart's own aspect. Overrides layout.fit.

href.description: optional URL — wraps the tile in an SVG link (fires when the SVG is a document, not inside )

titleAlign.description: bar / horizontal ONLY: "left" anchors the title at the left content edge so chart headers line up with list-style dashboard tiles (checklist etc.). Default "center".

total.description: iconarray ONLY: total number of icons

totalLabel.description: waterfall: label for the final total bar (default "Total")

trail.description: ts: true = WaveTeal trail palette. Default false (house teal).

type.description: chart type — the 47, sci-core (scatter/errorbar/lineplot/barplot/survival/blandaltman/qq/volcano), plus hidden marks pearl/ts. Required unless you pass local-only specPath whose JSON already has type.

valuePrefix.description: prefix before values, e.g. "$" — used by kpi value and pie/donut legend + center total

values.description: heatmap ONLY: a 2D matrix, values[row][col]; cells color light→dark by value

watermark.description: SlickFast mark, bottom-right, brand teal (default true). Free API and local MCP keep it on; paid API can set false.

year.description: calendar: which year the grid covers (default 2025)

name: render_chart
title: Render chart (SVG/PNG)
